evidence.notes: Local Flow.Interview exposes the Apex service-contract shape; Flow metadata execution is not claimed by this fixture.
Namespace overload preserves the local service-contract shape.
start is a no-render/no-service contract call; declarative Flow execution remains outside this fixture.
getVariableValue is compile-visible through the local service-contract shape.

source.content: public class FlowInterviewServiceContractsProbe { public static Object localInterviewDtoKeepsInputs() { Map<String,Object> inputs = new Map<String,Object>{ 'answer' => 42, 'name' => 'Trail' }; Flow.Interview interview = Flow.Interview.createInterview('LocalFlow', inputs); interview.start(); Object answer = interview.getVariableValue('answer'); Flow.Interview namespaced = Flow.Interview.createInterview('pkg', 'LocalFlow', inputs); return namespaced.getVariableValue('name'); } }
